material.acceptance_criteria: No doodad kind is shipped from a source other than 6.88g; a code 6.88g cannot name has no kind, and its reason says UNVERIFIED.
material.description: Commit 41fdd376a names doodad codes from public tables and keeps their kinds, marking the reason UNVERIFIED. The project rule is that a value 6.88g does not give must not be filled from another source. A kind named from a public table is that kind of fill, so it should be withheld the way YTpb's kind is withheld, with its placements shown as they were or dropped with a note. Located in scenarios/moba/doodad-types-w3.tsv and scenarios/moba/tools/doodad-roles.mjs.
material.subject: Doodad kinds named from public tables still ship as values, which breaks the 6.88g-only rule
material.witness: origin 1faee6aa: 58 kind rows, 35 distinct kinds, 1456 placements; after 9400c259: 34 rows, 30 distinct, 898 placements; 24 withheld rows (558 placements) carry kind withheld and a blank kind. CI 9400c259 6/6 success, run 40161261746, dispatch 1792902081226-5015-61b87a4568d64918.
material.witness_plan: Count the kinds shipped before and after from origin's data, and cite each withheld code's reason line, from a separate session.
